mapper.insert: insert into ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_like( article_id, liked_id, like_user, liked_user, like_type, is_read ) values( #{param.articleId}, #{param.likedId}, #{param.likeUser}, #{param.likedUser}, #{param.likeType}, #{param.isRead} )
mapper.select: select like_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_like where liked_id=#{param.remarkedId} and like_user=#{param.userId} and like_type=2

select a.like_id, a.article_id, a.liked_id, a.like_user, a.liked_user, a.like_type, a.create_time as likeTime, b.article_cover from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_like a left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info b on a.article_id = b.article_id inner join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info b on a.like_user = b.user_id where a.liked_user = #{param.userId} order by a.create_time desc
